name: Arithmetic Invariant Substitution
description: The pairwise inequality constraint (x != y) is replaced with a mathematically equivalent arithmetic invariant: (x^2 + y^2) / (x * y) is not an integer. By a known number-theoretic property, this ratio is an integer if and only if x = y for any positive integers. This completely removes any textual or logical hints of equality/inequality or swapping. Models that rely on surface-level text pattern matching to identify graph coloring will fail to recognize the equivalence and will simulate the arithmetic constraint dynamically, bypassing optimized coloring heuristics.
